google.cloud.monitoring_v3
from google.protobuf.timestamp_pb2 import Timestamp

def compare_metric_series(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    client = google.cloud.monitoring_v3.MetricServiceClient()
    project_id = payload["project_id"]
    project_name = f"projects/{project_id}"

    end_time = Timestamp()
    end_time.FromDatetime(
        datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(payload["end_time_iso"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    )

    start_time = Timestamp()
    start_time.FromDatetime(
        datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(payload["end_time_iso"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        - datetime.timedelta(seconds=payload["duration_seconds"])
    )

    interval = google.cloud.monitoring_v3.TimeInterval(end_time=end_time, start_time=start_time)

    aggregation = google.cloud.monitoring_v3.Aggregation(
        alignment_period=datetime.timedelta(seconds=payload["aggregation_period_seconds"]),
        per_series_aligner=google.cloud.monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Aligner.ALIGN_MEAN,
        cross_series_reducer=google.cloud.monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Reducer.REDUCE_NONE,
    )

    # Fetch data for series 1
    series_1_response = client.list_time_series(
        request={
            "name": project_name,
            "filter": payload["filter_series_1"],
            "interval": interval,
            "view": google.cloud.monitoring_v3.ListTimeSeriesRequest.TimeSeriesView.FULL,
            "aggregation": aggregation,
        }
    )
    series_1_data = [
        {"points": [p.value.double_value for p in ts.points], "resource": ts.resource.labels}
        for ts in series_1_response.time_series
    ]

    # Fetch data for series 2
    series_2_response = client.list_time_series(
        request={
            "name": project_name,
            "filter": payload["filter_series_2"],
            "interval": interval,
            "view": google.cloud.monitoring_v3.ListTimeSeriesRequest.TimeSeriesView.FULL,
            "aggregation": aggregation,
        }
    )
    series_2_data = [
        {"points": [p.value.double_value for p in ts.points], "resource": ts.resource.labels}
        for ts in series_2_response.time_series
    ]
    result = {
        "series_1": series_1_data,
        "series_2": series_2_data,
        "metric_type": payload["metric_type"],
        "interval_end": payload["end_time_iso"],
        "interval_duration_seconds": payload["duration_seconds"],
    }
    return result
